verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs describe gaming-relevant features (Arc integrated GPU, XeSS 3 upscaling, Binary Optimization Tool/Application Optimization for FPS gains, support for major game platforms) but all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no independent game benchmark results cited. Missing for 10: independent FPS/benchmark data from reviewers, comparison to competing chips' gaming performance, and hands-on validation of claimed 'ultra-smooth FPS'.
